title: M6 actual normalized trace, logical counting and witness correctness

spec.name: M6.ActualResult.boundary_normalized
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a b : M6.ActualTransfer.BP), M6.ActualTransfer.span a b < N → ∀ P : M6.Pinned.Pins (2*N), M6.Normalize.divide ((2 : ℤ)^(M6.ActualCounts.f N a b)) (M6.ActualTransfer.boundaryTrace N a b P) = M6.Pinned.enumerator (M6.Spaces.boundaryWords N (M6.Coordinates.coefficients N a) (M6.Coordinates.coefficients N b)) P
queries: polynomial coefficient finite sum integer division
spec.guidance: Use boundary_trace_inputs, actual boundary_pinned_sum and divide_scaled. Convert each natDegree≤span<N to degree<N; actual input sums definitionally match. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M6.ActualResult.cycle_normalized
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a b : M6.ActualTransfer.BP), M6.ActualTransfer.span a b < N → ∀ P : M6.Pinned.Pins (2*N), M6.Normalize.divide ((2 : ℤ)^N) (M6.ActualTransfer.characterTrace N a b P) = M6.Pinned.enumerator (M6.Spaces.cycleWords N (M6.Coordinates.coefficients N a) (M6.Coordinates.coefficients N b)) P
queries: polynomial coefficient finite sum integer division
spec.guidance: Use character_trace_inputs, actual cycle_pinned_sum and divide_scaled. No free oracle identity. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M6.ActualResult.Q_enumerator
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a b : M6.ActualTransfer.BP), M6.ActualTransfer.span a b < N → ∀ P : M6.Pinned.Pins (2*N), M6.ActualTransfer.Q N a b P = M6.Pinned.enumerator (M6.Spaces.logicalWords N (M6.Coordinates.coefficients N a) (M6.Coordinates.coefficients N b)) P
queries: polynomial coefficient finite sum integer division
spec.guidance: Unfold Q, use normalized identities and enumerator_sdiff with actual boundaries_are_cycles. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M6.ActualResult.Q_coeff
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a b : M6.ActualTransfer.BP), M6.ActualTransfer.span a b < N → ∀ (P : M6.Pinned.Pins (2*N)) (d : ℕ), (M6.ActualTransfer.Q N a b P).coeff d = M6.Pinned.count (M6.Spaces.logicalWords N (M6.Coordinates.coefficients N a) (M6.Coordinates.coefficients N b)) P d ∧ 0 ≤ (M6.ActualTransfer.Q N a b P).coeff d
queries: polynomial coefficient finite sum integer division
spec.guidance: Use actual Q_enumerator, accepted enumerator_coeff and count_nonnegative (check actual accepted name). Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M6.ActualResult.Q_zero
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a b : M6.ActualTransfer.BP), M6.ActualTransfer.span a b < N → ∀ P : M6.Pinned.Pins (2*N), (M6.ActualTransfer.Q N a b P).coeff 0 = 0
queries: polynomial coefficient finite sum integer division
spec.guidance: Use enumerator_zero_coeff and Spaces.zero_not_logical. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M6.ActualResult.Q_total
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a b : M6.ActualTransfer.BP), M6.ActualTransfer.span a b < N → Polynomial.eval 1 (M6.ActualTransfer.Q N a b (M6.Pinned.free (2*N))) = ((M6.Spaces.logicalWords N (M6.Coordinates.coefficients N a) (M6.Coordinates.coefficients N b)).card : ℤ)
queries: polynomial coefficient finite sum integer division
spec.guidance: Use enumerator_total. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M6.ActualResult.solve_exact
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a b : M6.ActualTransfer.BP), M6.ActualTransfer.span a b < N → (M6.ActualTransfer.solve N a b = none ↔ (M6.Spaces.logicalWords N (M6.Coordinates.coefficients N a) (M6.Coordinates.coefficients N b)) = ∅) ∧ ∀ (d : ℕ) (v : M6.Pinned.Vector (2*N)) (k : ℕ), M6.ActualTransfer.solve N a b = some (d,v,k) → v ∈ (M6.Spaces.logicalWords N (M6.Coordinates.coefficients N a) (M6.Coordinates.coefficients N b)) ∧ M6.Pinned.weight v = d ∧ (∀ u ∈ (M6.Spaces.logicalWords N (M6.Coordinates.coefficients N a) (M6.Coordinates.coefficients N b)), d ≤ M6.Pinned.weight u) ∧ k ≤ 2*N
queries: polynomial coefficient finite sum integer division
spec.guidance: Instantiate Pinned.solve_exact with actual Q_enumerator. This must be actual sparse Q and actual physical logical set. Return tactic lines without leading by.
